notes: A real spell-number 1 Armor affect expires through World.AffectUpdate and asserts the C literal plus CRLF before removal; spell number 0 remains silent as C requires (R1/R2/R5e/R5h).

A wizard switched into a blessed watcher receives "You feel less righteous." once when the affect expires: C's send_to_char reaches victim->desc, which do_switch set to the wizard's descriptor, and the last-record condition silences the second bless record (R1/R2/R3/R5e/R5h).
Two spells expiring together speak in C's newest-first ch->affected order (OrderedAffects), each delivered to the switched body's descriptor (R1/R3/R5e/R5h).
A two-record bless affect speaks once, proving the last-record condition suppresses the newer expiring record so a multi-record spell is not announced twice (R1/R3/R5e/R5h).
